topic: Why service-based businesses using AI outreach are booking 3x more discovery calls
findings: AI SDR / outreach tools improve meeting booking rates by 30-40% versus manual outreach
Personalized outreach nearly doubles reply rates - 18% for highly personalized messages vs 9% for generic ones
AI-driven outreach cuts cost per qualified opportunity by roughly 54% compared to human-only outreach
41% of enterprise B2B teams now run at least one AI SDR tool in production, up from 3% in early 2024
